title: PensionRightsFrontCoverSchema
description: Fields for the front cover of a Pension Rights Certificate.

main_title.description: The main title text at the top of the front cover (e.g. 'Pension Rights Certificate').

authority_line_1.description: Upper authority line at the bottom of the front cover (e.g. department or ministry; extract exactly as printed, transliterate in output).

authority_line_2.description: Lower authority line at the bottom of the front cover (e.g. Police Record Office, Police Kitabkhana, or similar; extract exactly as printed).
